secured an $8B maximum-ceiling contract from the U.S. Air Force Nuclear Weapons Center on Tuesday.
The contract is to modernize strategic communications terminals, restart production, and conduct technical studies.
The 10-year contract runs through October 12, 2036, with work in Marlborough, Massachusetts, and Largo, Florida.
The Air Force is obligating $800K in fiscal 2026 R&D, testing, and evaluation funds at award.
The Air Force Nuclear Weapons Center is the contracting activity.

title: RTX wins up to $8B Air Force deal to modernize nuclear communications
